title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Working Balance Kept on Program Accounts
content:
**Working balance — Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs.** When a lender asks for its program credit balance to be refunded, Tidemark keeps on the account, without taking the refundable credit below zero, 1000 dollars when 12 or more certificates were issued under the program in the last 12 months, 500 dollars when 5 to 11 were, and nothing when fewer than 5 were.

The count takes every issue entry of the program, on any loan, processed within the refund window of the last 12 months — every entry dated on a day from which fewer than 12 whole calendar months have passed by today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached. Renewal entries are not issue entries.

| Certificates issued in the last 12 months | Working balance kept |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 5 | Nothing |
| 5 to 11 | 500 dollars |
| 12 or more | 1000 dollars |

*Edge:* exactly 5 issued certificates keep 500 dollars; exactly 12 keep 1000 dollars.
